context: Smart Contract & Web3 Protocol Security Audit

vulnerabilities.title: Reentrancy Attack
vulnerabilities.description: An external call is made before state modifications, allowing an attacker to re-enter the function and drain funds.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Implement checks-effects-interactions pattern. Use OpenZeppelin ReentrancyGuard.

vulnerabilities.title: tx.origin Used for Authentication
vulnerabilities.description: Using tx.origin for authorization can be subverted by a phishing attack.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Use msg.sender for authorization checks instead of tx.origin.

vulnerabilities.title: Unprotected selfdestruct Instruction
vulnerabilities.description: An unprotected selfdestruct instruction allows any user to destroy the contract and potentially steal its balance.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Ensure selfdestruct is heavily protected, preferably with multi-signature or removed entirely in modern designs.

vulnerabilities.title: Integer Overflow and Underflow
vulnerabilities.description: Mathematical operation may result in integer overflow or underflow in Solidity versions prior to 0.8.0.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Use compiler version >= 0.8.0 which has built-in overflow checks, or use SafeMath.

vulnerabilities.title: Delegatecall to Untrusted Callee
vulnerabilities.description: Calling delegatecall to a user-supplied address allows them to execute arbitrary code in the context of the calling contract.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Never use delegatecall with user-supplied inputs.

vulnerabilities.title: Block values as a proxy for time
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Do not rely strictly on block.timestamp for randomness or precise timing.

vulnerabilities.title: Unchecked Call Return Value
vulnerabilities.description: The return value of a message call is not checked.
real_world_examples: Poly Network hack (partially related to unprotected calls)
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Ensure that the return value of an external call is checked.

vulnerabilities.title: Unencrypted Private Data On-Chain
vulnerabilities.description: Private visibility modifier does not prevent data from being readable off-chain.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Do not store sensitive data in clear text on the blockchain.

vulnerabilities.title: Transaction Order Dependence
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Use commit-reveal schemes or slippage limits.

vulnerabilities.title: Weak Sources of Randomness from Chain Attributes
vulnerabilities.description: Using block.difficulty or blockhash for randomness.

vulnerabilities.title: Unprotected Ether Withdrawal
vulnerabilities.description: Missing access controls on withdrawal functions.

vulnerabilities.title: DoS with Failed Call
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Avoid external calls in loops. Favor pull over push.

vulnerabilities.title: Arbitrary Jump with Function Type Variable
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Avoid inline assembly for control flow.

vulnerabilities.title: Shadowing State Variables
vulnerabilities.description: Local variables shadow state variables, leading to incorrect logic.
